Pick a task and get hands-on: the reasoning behind it, a runnable example, and the
decisions you'll actually need to make. Guides are standalone, so read the one you
need rather than the whole set in order. For the sequential map of the whole
pipeline, see the [Workflows overview](../overview/index.qmd); for exhaustive parameter
listings, see the [reference](../reference/index.qmd).

Filter by the kind of data you have below. Some guides apply to both single-cell
and spatial data.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
These guides assume you already have a working setup: local Nextflow + Docker, or
a Seqera Platform or Viash Hub account. If not, start with
[Quickstart](../get-started/index.qmd): it covers install and walks one run end
to end.
:::

<script>
(function () {
  var buttons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#guide-filter button"));
  var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".guide-grid .rcard[data-type]"));
  if (!buttons.length || !cards.length) return;
  // Single-select: "Single-cell" shows single-cell guides plus those covering
  // both data types, likewise for "Spatial". Cards without a data-type (the
  // technical guides) are never filtered.
  function apply(type) {
    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      var t = c.dataset.type;
      c.style.display = (type === "all" || t === "both" || t === type) ? "" : "none";
    });
  }
  buttons.forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      buttons.forEach(function (x) {
        x.classList.toggle("on", x === b);
        x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x === b ? "true" : "false");
      });
      apply(b.dataset.type);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
